synopsis: Keith 在清晨向 Bree 求婚，Bree 觉得太快但同意让他搬来同居；Susan 在电话里和远在阿拉斯加的 Mike 商量要不要把 Renee 暗恋 Tom 的事告诉 Lynette；Juanita 偷看到 Gaby 写给 Grace 的信，得知 Grace 是亲生的，崩溃跑出家门；Paul 在业委会上假称已拿到所有票，被揭穿；Lee 设局骗 Lynette 说自己撮合 Mitzi 卖房逃离，结果 Mitzi 当面回绝，Lynette 反被陷害；Brent Ferguson 带头在市长颁奖现场抗议，发展成暴乱，Susan 被踩踏昏迷，Juanita 爬上车顶求救，Keith 误把上前调戏 Bree 的父亲 Richard 揍了一顿。

cards.example: Once the Mayor begins his speech, I'll give the signal — that's when we all start our protest.
cards.example_translation: 市长一开始讲话，我就发信号——到时大家就一起开始抗议。

cards.example: The crowd began to chant 'Save our street' in unison.
cards.example_translation: 人群开始齐声喊「救救我们的街道」。

cards.example: Last year some old hippie tried to open a drug rehab center on our block.
cards.example_translation: 去年有个嬉皮士老头想在我们这条街开戒毒康复中心。

cards.example: Whoever's trying to open this halfway house, we could really scare the hell out of him.
cards.example_translation: 不管谁想开这个中途之家，我们绝对能把他吓个半死。

cards.example: Don't panic — just grab my hand and don't let go.
cards.example_translation: 别慌——抓住我的手，别松开。

cards.example: In the aftermath of the riot, several residents were taken to hospital.
cards.example_translation: 暴乱的余波中，多位居民被送进了医院。

cards.example: She humiliated me in front of the whole neighborhood.
cards.example_translation: 她当着我们整个社区的面让我下不来台。

cards.example: Her obsession with Tom has been obvious to everyone except her husband.
cards.example_translation: 她对 Tom 的执念所有人都看得出来，就她老公没察觉。

cards.example: If this scandal gets out, it will destroy her marriage.
cards.example_translation: 这桩丑闻一旦曝光，她的婚姻就完了。

cards.example: The crowd became hostile the moment the mayor started speaking.
cards.example_translation: 市长一开口讲话，人群就充满了敌意。

cards.example: He's trying to intimidate us into selling our houses.
cards.example_translation: 他就是想吓我们，让我们把房子卖掉。

cards.example: Mitzi is financially vulnerable, which is why Paul targeted her.
cards.example_translation: Mitzi 经济上很脆弱，所以 Paul 才挑她下手。

cards.example: Don't blame me for what happened — I'm just the messenger.
cards.example_translation: 出了事别怪我——我只是个传话的。

cards.example: After 20 years, she finally confessed the truth to her best friend.
cards.example_translation: 20 年后，她终于向最好的朋友坦白了真相。

cards.example: The affair happened 20 years ago, but it still haunts their friendship.
cards.example_translation: 那段婚外情发生在 20 年前，但依然在影响她们的友情。

cards.example: If Lynette finds out, it will devastate her.
cards.example_translation: Lynette 要是知道了，她会崩溃的。

cards.example: The mayor is in a close race for re-election — that's why he needs our votes.
cards.example_translation: 市长正在激烈的连任竞选中——这就是他为什么需要我们的选票。

cards.example: Quite a turnout today — look at all those news cameras.
cards.example_translation: 今天人真多——看那些新闻摄像机。

cards.example: If Mitzi had sold, the neighbors would have pummeled her.
cards.example_translation: 如果 Mitzi 真卖了，邻居们肯定会把她揍一顿。

cards.example: We only have one item on the agenda tonight: the halfway house vote.
cards.example_translation: 今晚议程只有一项：就是中途之家的投票。
